atoms.exact_source_text: EMBODY is the fifth canon Register and is named the Embodiment Register.
atoms.normalized_claim: EMBODY is declared the fifth canon Register, named the Embodiment Register.

atoms.exact_source_text: EMBODY is globally available within Home Mode when Quiet Equilibrium is active.
atoms.normalized_claim: EMBODY is available globally within Home Mode whenever Quiet Equilibrium is active.

atoms.exact_source_text: The player enters EMBODY through any present, available Citizen or suitable inhabited Place.
atoms.normalized_claim: The player enters EMBODY through any present, available Citizen or suitable inhabited Place.

atoms.exact_source_text: EMBODY is Home-only and never appears during an Expedition.
atoms.normalized_claim: EMBODY is Home-only and never appears during an Expedition.
